senses.gloss: छेद mfn. ifc. ‘cutting off’, see स्थाणु-
छेद m. divisor, denominator, VarBṛ. viii, 4; Laghuj. vii, 6
a cut, section, piece, portion, R. ii, 61, 14; Ragh.; VarBṛS. &c.
an incision, cleft, slit, liii, 122
lxxi, 4 f.
cutting off, tearing off dividing (often ifc.), Mn. viii; Yājñ. &c.
separation (of syllables or words), Sarvad. v, 109; MBh. xii, 101, 5, Sch.
dissipating (doubt, &c.), W.
interruption, vanishing, cessation, deprivation, want, xiii, 1637; Śak.; Vikr.; VarBṛS. &c.
limit of (in comp.), Yājñ. i, 319
smoothing (a conflict, by an ordeal, दिव्य-), Kathās. lx, 222
छेद cf. ऋण-.
छेदी f. g. गौरादि (not in Gaṇar.)
छेदि mfn. one who cuts or breaks, Uṇ. iv, 118, Sch.
छेदि m. a carpenter, ib.
छेद—कर mfn. making incisions, Jain.
छेद—कर m. a wood-cutter, W.
छेद—गम m. disappearance of the denominator.
छेदादि a Gaṇa of Pāṇ. (v, 1, 64; Gaṇar. 370).
छेदोपस्थापनीय n. taking the (Jain) vows after having broken with doctrines or practices adhered to formerly, Jain.
छेदक mfn. ifc. cutting off, Kathās. lxi, 31
छेदक m. the denominator of a fraction
cf. ग्रन्थि-.
छेदन mfn. cutting asunder, splitting, MBh. i, 1498; ii, 1953
destroying, removing (ifc.), xiv, 423
छेदन n. an instrument for cutting, Hcat. i, 9, 204
section, part, L.
(chiefly ifc.) cutting, removal (of doubts, संशय-), MBh. iii, xv; Hariv. 913
a medicine for removing the humors of the body, Bhpr.
छेदनीय mfn. to be cut up or divided, Suśr. i; Nyāyam. i, 4, 56, Sch.
छेदनीय m. Strychnos potatorum, L.
छेदित mfn. cut, divided, L.
छेदितव्य mfn. to be cut, divisible, W.
छेदिन् mfn. ifc. cutting off, tearing asunder, Mn. iv, 71; Ragh.
removing, Hariv. 15880; Śak.
छेद्य mfn. to be cut or divided or split or cut off or mutilated, Yājñ. ii, 215; MBh. i, 93; xii, &c.
छेद्य n. cutting off, cutting, tearing (with teeth or nails), v, 5733 (C.); Suśr. i, 5, 1; vi; Sāh. vi, 17
cf. कुड्य-, दुःक्क-, पत्त्र-, लघु-, संशय-.
छेद्यक n. drawing, projection, Sūryas. vi, 1 and 12.
छेद्यकाध्याय m. N. of Sūryas. vi.
